Then this is the perfect job for you!Your responsibilities:- You use your forklift to transport empty cans to the production line, making sure your colleagues always have the supplies they need.- You keep your work area clean and safe, and step in to support the production process as an operator on our modern production line.- Every day is different: one day you are driving the forklift, the next you are directly involved in the production process.- You work in a friendly team, and together you make sure everything runs smoothly!Working hours & shift schedule:Until December 2026, you will work in a 3-shift rotation:- Week 1: 4–5 night shifts (22:00–06:00)- Week 2: 3 afternoon shifts (14:00–22:00) and 2 morning shifts (06:00–14:00)- Week 3: 3 morning shifts (06:00–14:00) and 2 afternoon shifts (14:00–22:00)From January 2027 onwards, you will switch to a dynamic 5-shift rotation:- 2 morning shifts (06:00–14:00)- 2 afternoon shifts (14:00–22:00)- 2 night shifts (22:00–06:00)After these six shifts, you will have 4 days off, giving you plenty of time to relax and recharge!- You have a forklift certificate or are willing to get one. - You speak Dutch or English- You don’t mind working in shifts. - You live within 40 kilometers of Lieshout.
